query_text: SELECT area, city_name, gdp FROM city
SELECT nba_team, name, own_year FROM owner
SELECT state_name, area, city_name FROM city WHERE area = 375.78
SELECT state_name, area, city_name FROM city WHERE area != 1314.80 AND population = 887642
SELECT age, nba_team, name FROM owner WHERE nba_team != 'Cleveland Cavaliers'
SELECT age, nba_team, name FROM owner WHERE nba_team != 'Golden State Warriors' AND age >= 66
SELECT mvp_awards, draft_pick, fiba_world_cup FROM player WHERE fiba_world_cup <= 0
SELECT position, nationality, age FROM player WHERE age < 91
SELECT founded_year, ownership, team_name FROM team WHERE ownership != '  '
SELECT ownership, championship, founded_year FROM team WHERE founded_year < 1989
SELECT position, MIN(olympic_gold_medals) AS min_olympic_gold_medals FROM player GROUP BY position
SELECT position, AVG(age) AS avg_age FROM player GROUP BY position
SELECT team.championship, team.location, player.age, player.olympic_gold_medals FROM player JOIN team ON player.team = team.team_name
SELECT team.founded_year, team.team_name, player.name, player.team FROM player JOIN team ON player.team = team.team_name
SELECT player.position, MIN(player.olympic_gold_medals) AS min_player_olympic_gold_medals FROM player JOIN team ON player.team = team.team_name GROUP BY player.position

SELECT player.position, MIN(player.olympic_gold_medals) AS min_player_olympic_gold_medals FROM player JOIN team ON player.team = team.team_name JOIN owner ON team.ownership = owner.name JOIN city ON team.location = city.city_name GROUP BY player.position
SELECT nationality, SUM(age) AS sum_age FROM owner WHERE age != 76 AND nba_team != 'Houston Rockets' GROUP BY nationality
SELECT nationality, COUNT(*) AS count_all FROM player WHERE name = 'Antonius Cleveland' OR nba_championships >= 0 GROUP BY nationality

SELECT player.nationality, MIN(player.olympic_gold_medals) AS min_player_olympic_gold_medals FROM player JOIN team ON player.team = team.team_name WHERE player.fiba_world_cup > 0 GROUP BY player.nationality

SELECT owner.nationality, MAX(player.mvp_awards) AS max_player_mvp_awards FROM player JOIN team ON player.team = team.team_name JOIN owner ON team.ownership = owner.name JOIN city ON team.location = city.city_name WHERE city.population < 1603797 OR team.location != 'Minneapolis' GROUP BY owner.nationality
SELECT nationality, MIN(age) AS min_age FROM owner WHERE nba_team != 'Cleveland Cavaliers' GROUP BY nationality
SELECT team, MIN(olympic_gold_medals) AS min_olympic_gold_medals FROM player WHERE draft_pick < 1 GROUP BY team
SELECT nationality, SUM(olympic_gold_medals) AS sum_olympic_gold_medals FROM player WHERE nationality = 'German' AND olympic_gold_medals <= 0 GROUP BY nationality
SELECT player.draft_pick, team.team_name, player.fiba_world_cup, team.location FROM player JOIN team ON player.team = team.team_name WHERE player.fiba_world_cup > 0

SELECT owner.age, team.founded_year, player.name, city.city_name FROM player JOIN team ON player.team = team.team_name JOIN owner ON team.ownership = owner.name JOIN city ON team.location = city.city_name WHERE player.birth_date > '1994/2/2' AND city.population > 715522
